concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a refined Parcela software mascot icon. Parcela gives each development project its own enclosed space; the name evokes a parcel/plot of land and the existing mascot is a fence picket. The user likes reference image 1's compact blue character but finds it unrelated to Parcela. Reference 1 is a character/style reference, reference 2 is a semantic fence-picket reference ONLY. Make the connection to a fence and an enclosed space obvious in the silhouette itself. Keep the friendliness, squat proportions, two small charcoal eyes, off-white face and deep sky-blue #07668f of reference 1, while removing the generic antenna/robot reading. Flat precise vector-like graphic with solid fills, sophisticated soft corners, minimal geometric forms. No gradients, texture, 3D, shadows, glow, lettering, wordmark, watermark, scene, tools, props or backdrop. Single large icon centered in square canvas with 15% breathing room on genuinely transparent background. Readable as a brand icon at 24px, not a detailed illustration. Design direction A — FENCE BUDDY: a single compact character whose blue body is literally a short panel of picket fence. Three broad joined vertical pickets define the upper silhouette, each with a gently pointed pentagonal top, the central picket slightly taller. A very simple off-white horizontal inset across the middle carries the two dark eyes, appearing like the front fence rail rather than a robot visor. The connected base has two tiny integrated blue feet. Only two short dark-blue seams imply the separation of the three boards; do not add wood grain or multiple rails. It must look like a friendly little fence, not a castle/crown, robot, animal or house. Minimal bold white-and-blue shapes, no thick dark external outline.

Design direction B — PICKET ENCLOSURE: evolve reference 1 into a friendly enclosure character, with a broad chunky U-shaped deep-blue body framing its off-white face. The two vertical sides of the U extend upward as two unmistakable broad fence posts ending in soft triangular picket tips, one slightly taller, replacing the single rounded antenna. The lower U gently joins two short integrated feet. The two eyes sit in the generous off-white central opening. A small blue horizontal fence-rail detail bridges the side posts just below the eyes, integrated into the shape and without crossing the eyes. Front-on, no perspective. Overall compact and almost square. The defining visual is an enclosed private space held between two pickets; avoid cat ears (make posts visibly vertical boards, not triangular ears attached to a head), castle battlements, robot antennae and house roofs. This should be an ownable clean software mascot, not a literal detailed garden.
